name: Chatwoot
description: Chatwoot is an open-source customer support and engagement platform with a shared inbox and live chat. Self-host it on your own server with Panara Cloud, which deploys Chatwoot as a Docker Compose service in a few clicks.
seoDescription: Shared inbox and live chat for customer support. Self-host Chatwoot on Panara Cloud in minutes – no manual setup needed.
